title: Cancel BHIM UPI AutoPay: Pause or Revoke Mandates (2026)
metaDescription: Stop unwanted UPI AutoPay debits in BHIM. Pause or cancel a mandate with MyUPI, understand a debit already due, and use NPCI's help route if the app fails.
h1: How do you pause or cancel a UPI AutoPay mandate in BHIM?
summary: BHIM's MyUPI assistant shows recurring UPI payments in one place, including mandates created in other UPI apps, and lets you pause, restart or cancel a payment depending on the mandate. Cancelling stops future debits but does not reverse a payment that has already gone through, so act before the next pre-debit notification. If the app will not act, NPCI's UPI Help assistant and your bank are the fallbacks.
stepsHeading: How to pause or cancel a BHIM UPI AutoPay mandate

steps.name: Open BHIM and find MyUPI
steps.text: Open the BHIM Payments app and look for MyUPI, the AI assistant added to the app. It brings recurring UPI payments into one view, including mandates created through other UPI apps. The entry point can differ by app version, so look for it on the home screen or in the menu.

steps.name: Find the mandate you want to stop
steps.text: Locate the merchant or service. Note the amount, frequency and next debit date shown, so you can match it to the pre-debit notification you receive before the debit. If MyUPI does not list it, try the AutoPay or Mandates section.

steps.name: Choose pause or cancel
steps.text: Pause stops debits for now, and cancel ends the mandate. The options depend on the mandate, so do not assume both are available. Choose the one that matches what you want.

steps.name: Confirm the change
steps.text: Complete the confirmation, which may need your UPI PIN or biometrics. Screenshot the confirmation screen and any reference number.

steps.name: Check the status
steps.text: Reopen the mandate list and confirm that it shows as paused or cancelled. Keep the screenshot in case a debit arrives later.

steps.name: Cancel the service with the merchant
steps.text: Stopping the mandate does not end your account with the merchant on its own. Cancel the subscription in the merchant's app or website as well, so the service does not keep expecting payment.

steps.name: Use NPCI's help route if the app fails
steps.text: If you cannot find the mandate or the app will not act on it, use NPCI's UPI Help assistant at upihelp.npci.org.in. NPCI says the assistant can help you view and manage mandates. Your bank can also help with a mandate that will not stop.

sections.heading: Where BHIM keeps your mandates
paragraphs: MyUPI is an AI-powered assistant inside the BHIM Payments app, introduced by NBSL, a wholly owned subsidiary of NPCI. A report on the launch in Outlook Money says it lets you view UPI transactions linked to your bank accounts and UPI apps in one place, and that recurring payments are brought under one view, including mandates created in other UPI apps.
I could not confirm from BHIM's own help pages the exact button that opens a single mandate. Treat the steps above as a guide and check the screen in your app version.

sections.heading: Pause versus cancel
paragraphs: A pause stops debits for a mandate without removing it. The Outlook Money report says users can pause, restart or cancel a recurring payment depending on the mandate, so the options differ case by case. Cancelling ends the mandate. If you want the service back later, the merchant will usually need a fresh approval with your UPI PIN.

The merchant's setup also affects what you can do. Razorpay's developer FAQ says a UPI mandate cannot be modified, only paused or cancelled by the customer from the UPI app. It also says a merchant using its platform can switch off the pause and cancel buttons in UPI apps. If the buttons are missing for one of your mandates, the restriction may come from the merchant rather than from BHIM.

sections.heading: What happens to a debit that is already due
paragraphs: According to Razorpay's developer FAQ, a pre-debit notification goes out about 24 hours before a UPI AutoPay debit. That notice is your window to pause or cancel. Once a debit has gone through, cancelling the mandate stops future debits but does not reverse that payment.

If a debit you did not expect still goes through after you cancel, raise a complaint for that transaction in BHIM first. Under the UPI dispute order that CRED's UPI FAQ reproduces, the complaint then goes to the PSP bank, your bank, NPCI, and finally the Banking Ombudsman or the Ombudsman for Digital Complaints. Keep your screenshots and the transaction reference for each step.

sections.heading: Do not confuse the Safety Switch with a pause
paragraphs: MyUPI also has a Safety Switch for situations such as a lost phone or a suspicious debit. Outlook Money describes it as blocking a linked bank account to stop further transactions from that account. That is a blunt tool. It affects every payment from the account, not just one mandate, so use it only when you need a full stop.
Confirm with your bank how the account is restored before you use it.

sections.heading: How tracking renewals in Essara helps
paragraphs: Essara is a manual tracker. You add each mandate yourself, and it shows the auto-debits due in the coming week and month. It does not connect to your bank, UPI app or SMS, and it never asks for your UPI PIN, so it cannot pause a mandate for you. It simply keeps the date in front of you before the pre-debit window closes.

faqs.q: Can I pause a UPI AutoPay mandate in BHIM?
faqs.a: Yes, according to Outlook Money's report on the MyUPI launch, users can pause, restart or cancel a recurring payment depending on the mandate. I could not confirm the exact button in BHIM's own help pages, so check the mandate screen in your app version.

faqs.q: Will cancelling in BHIM refund my last debit?
faqs.a: Not by itself. Cancelling stops future debits, but it does not reverse a payment that has already been processed. If a debit you did not authorise went through, raise a UPI complaint for that transaction, starting in the app, and escalate if the first step does not resolve it.

faqs.q: Why is there no pause or cancel button for my mandate?
faqs.a: Razorpay's developer FAQ says a merchant can restrict pausing and cancelling, which removes those buttons from UPI apps. If that is the case, you need to end the service with the merchant. If the debits continue, use the complaint route and NPCI's help assistant.

faqs.q: How much notice do I get before a UPI AutoPay debit?
faqs.a: Pre-debit notifications go out about 24 hours before the debit, according to Razorpay's developer FAQ. That gives you a window to pause or cancel, so set a reminder as soon as you receive the notice.

faqs.q: Can I stop every UPI debit from my bank at once?
faqs.a: BHIM's Safety Switch can block a linked bank account to stop further transactions from it. That affects every payment from the account, not one mandate, so use it only for a full stop.
